qa.overall_assessment: The overlap detection implementation in validate-timeline-data.py is correct, well-structured, and handles all specified edge cases properly.

tests_run.details: Python AST parse succeeded with no errors.

tests_run.name: Real data test: china-feb-15-mar-7-2026 timeline.json
tests_run.details: Script exited with code 0. 21/21 days with data, 100% coverage, PASS status. No conflicts detected.

tests_run.name: Edge case: Hard conflict (partial overlap, non-optional)
tests_run.details: Two non-optional activities overlapping 09:00-11:30 and 11:00-13:00 correctly produced a hard conflict and exit code 1.

tests_run.name: Edge case: Nested activity (one contains the other)
tests_run.details: Activity 08:00-18:00 fully containing 12:00-13:00 was correctly skipped (no conflict reported), exit code 0.

tests_run.name: Edge case: Soft conflict (optional keyword in name)
tests_run.details: 'Optional Coffee Tour' overlapping with non-optional 'Museum Visit' correctly produced a soft conflict (warning only), exit code 0.

tests_run.name: Edge case: Soft conflict (optional=true field)
tests_run.details: Entry with optional:true overlapping a non-optional entry correctly produced a soft conflict, exit code 0.

tests_run.name: Edge case: Soft conflict ('alternative' keyword in name)
tests_run.details: 'Alternative: Art Gallery' overlapping a non-optional entry correctly produced a soft conflict, exit code 0.

tests_run.name: Edge case: No conflict (non-overlapping activities)
tests_run.details: Three activities with no time overlap produced no conflicts, exit code 0.

tests_run.name: Edge case: Transit entries skipped
tests_run.details: Transit entry with transit:true overlapping a non-transit entry was correctly ignored, exit code 0.

tests_run.name: Edge case: Boundary (adjacent activities, end == start)
tests_run.details: Activities ending at 10:00 and starting at 10:00 correctly produced no overlap (half-open interval [s,e)), exit code 0.

tests_run.name: Edge case: Reverse nested (smaller listed first)
tests_run.details: Smaller activity 10:00-10:30 with larger 08:00-20:00 (b_contains_a path) correctly skipped, exit code 0.

checks: All three paths tested and confirmed working
Transit entries (entry.get('transit')) are skipped before comparison
Entries without start_time or end_time are skipped
Overlap formula: s1 < e2 AND s2 < e1 is mathematically correct for half-open intervals
Nested detection: a_contains_b (s1<=s2 and e2<=e1) and b_contains_a (s2<=s1 and e1<=e2) both checked
Uses itertools.combinations(entries, 2) for pairwise comparison - correct and complete
Exit 0: valid data with >50% coverage and no hard conflicts
Exit 1: invalid structure, low coverage, or hard conflicts
Exit 2: file not found or JSON parse error

docstrings.validate_timeline_data: present - documents args and return values

code_quality.structure: clean - functions are focused and single-purpose, type hints used on function signatures, proper use of itertools.combinations
code_quality.error_handling: comprehensive - handles file not found, JSON decode errors, invalid structure, type mismatches on timeline dict
code_quality.naming: good - _is_optional, _check_day_overlaps use clear verb-noun pattern with underscore prefix for internal functions

issues_found.recommendation: Add a brief docstring, though this is a trivial CLI entry point so impact is minimal.

summary.narrative: All overlap detection logic is correct. The _is_optional function properly checks three sources (field, 'optional' in name, 'alternative' in name). The _check_day_overlaps function correctly skips transit entries, uses the standard half-open interval overlap formula (s1 < e2 AND s2 < e1), properly skips nested activities in both directions, and routes conflicts to hard vs soft lists based on optional status. Real data test passed. All 9 edge case tests passed covering hard conflicts, soft conflicts, nested activities, transit skipping, boundary conditions, and no-conflict scenarios. Only one minor finding: missing docstring on trivial main() function.
